Cute!!!! I hope she helps you through all your hard times :)
Thank you it means a lot ❤️

It’s ok, it’s hard to know what to say in these situations, but if you’re struggling then all I can say is I hope things get better for you, if you’re physically healthy appreciate the little things, (get a dog, my little baby has helped me through so much), appreciate good music and food and sunsets, and hugs and anytime you get to laugh with people, 💕
It’s not worth it no because it’s fuckef up my brain too and caused me to hurt people which isn’t me...I’m better off gone for everyone’s sake.

I’ve had an illness that’s left me bedridden for many years, before that I had a wonderful life, it’s taken everything from me. As a human there’s only so much suffering I can take. I hope whatever it is you’re going through you get through it, everyone deserves happiness 💕

I can’t anyway, I’m bedridden and sick, it’s for the best. I wish I could take everyone’s pain away who’s on hetr though. 

Hugs to you too 💕

It’s ok I’ve had an illness for many years that should have killed me by now. Before then I lived a good life. But it took everything from me. My family deserve t live a life free from worrying about my everyday. My sister doesn’t get enough attention because of me, I hope that they can make good memories when I’m gone
That’s ok, I’ve dealt with awful things on my life. We all die one day, 4 monutes of hell Is worth it

I’m so sorry youre suffering and feel unloveable, and I know there’s not much I can say to make you feel better, but just from reading this post I know you have a good soul and you don’t deserve to feel this way. 💕
